channel.title: Korea Programs Navigator — Active Programs

item.title: Hankook University startup lab: incubator space available
item.description: New venture with strong technology? Get office space and mentorship from experienced accelerators.

item.title: Protect your users' data: location privacy workshop
item.description: Free training on legal compliance and best practices for startups using location data.

item.title: Free office at Chungbuk Global Tech Venture Center
item.description: Chungbuk National University's BI incubator has space for promising tech startups. Get mentoring, investor intros, and lab access for free.

item.title: Venture certification diagnosis (free coaching)
item.description: Free diagnostic assessment to benchmark your startup against venture certification criteria. Get custom coaching to close gaps.

item.title: Deep tech + national strategy: R&D matching platform
item.description: Pair your startup with government research labs. Co-develop next-gen tech. Daejeon-based.

item.title: Synergy Core Cohort 4 (investment track)
item.description: Synergy IB Venture invests in startups at every stage—from seed through growth and IPO. Apply now to accelerate your runway.

item.description: Gwangmyeong City will incubate and fund innovative startups anchoring in the region. Come build here.

item.description: POSTECH Holdings invests in and mentors hard-tech startups—AI, biotech, hardware. Apply to get matched with advisors and capital.

item.title: Scale your startup's impact in developing markets
item.description: South Korea's development agency backs startups that combine sustainable business with development aid. Open call for 2026–27 projects.

item.description: Practical 4-week course on business fundamentals for founders and early-stage teams. June cohort now enrolling.

item.title: Sell to big companies: MRO supplier summit

item.title: Protect your small business: brand + design IP
item.description: Busan funds small business owners to develop brand identity and design assets, then registers the IP for legal protection.

item.title: Government procurement channel: boost B2B sales
item.description: Startups get institutional sponsorship to sell into Korea's public procurement platform—steady revenue without the pitch.

item.title: Startup course for 40+ founders in Chilgok
item.description: Free boot camp to learn startup fundamentals and build confidence. Open to mid-career career-changers.

item.title: Digital factory: hands-on training for manufacturing leaders
item.description: Learn real-world DX skills—data pipelines, process monitoring, dashboards, simulation—then use them immediately on the factory floor. Sponsored by Gyeonggi TechnoParc.

item.title: Chungcheong startup launchpad: validate your idea
item.description: Korea Tech University backs pre-launch and new ventures in Chungnam with mentorship and funding.

item.title: Cloud infrastructure vouchers for smart city startups
item.description: Cheonan-based companies get cloud credits to upgrade infrastructure. Urban tech founders welcome.

item.title: Biotech startup competition: find your next investor
item.description: Dongguk University's BMC incubator searches for cutting-edge biomedical ideas. Win recognition, funding, and mentorship.

item.title: Go to Silicon Valley: 12-week accelerator with IBK
item.description: IBK + 500 Global US-expansion program: 4 weeks in Korea, then 8 in Silicon Valley. Investment is confirmed if you're selected. 4 founder teams.

item.title: Women's startup incubator: grow your idea
item.description: Desk space and support for women founders at Daegu's incubator.

item.title: Gwangjin startup hub: mentoring and fundraising
item.description: Office space, consulting by growth stage, and investor introductions.

item.title: Machine learning bootcamp: no math required
item.description: Learn ML theory and hands-on coding. No background needed.

item.title: ESG supply chain consulting for exporters
item.description: Free ESG compliance and green supply chain guidance. For export-focused SMEs.

item.title: Bring Korean tech to global development
item.description: CTS program (2026–2027) funds Korean innovators to apply their tech solving real problems in developing nations. Open to social-impact founders.

item.title: Fashion + beauty e-commerce bootcamp for women
item.description: Hands-on training in locomo (location-based shopping) e-commerce. Seoul government-funded.

item.title: Design to market: CMF + manufacturing bootcamp
item.description: Free 1-on-1 coaching from Intops—40-year manufacturing partner to Samsung and Hyundai. Design, specs, production.

item.description: Global startups: apply to enter, settle, and scale in Korea. Full support package includes visas, mentoring, office space, and investor matching.

item.title: Build your ESG startup with matching funds
item.description: Hana's 2026 ESG Double Impact Matching Fund supports startups solving social problems while growing your business. Get paired with investment capital and mentorship.

item.title: ICT Innovation Center — space + mentoring
item.description: Chungbuk ICT Center has always-open admissions for tech startups. Free office, equipment, and networking with corporate partners.

item.title: Gen AI bootcamp: become a founder-developer
item.description: Free government-funded course: learn to build, launch, and pitch AI-powered products as a solo founder or technical co-founder.

item.title: E-commerce bootcamp for women — AI-powered shops
item.description: Launch a marketplace or online store. Cohort limited to 22 women with e-commerce goals.

item.title: Moonshot Challenge: solve defense tech problems
item.description: Tackle Korea's defense innovation challenges. Submit solutions and compete for funding.

item.title: Free AI consulting for your small business
item.description: Government-funded AI training program: free customized consulting, hands-on skills, and project support to help your team adopt AI safely.

item.title: Solo founder AI bootcamp, fully funded
item.description: Free intensive program for solo founders building AI services. Learn development and launch strategy.

item.title: Incubator office at Namseoul University (Cheonan)
item.description: Workspace, mentor, network. Early-stage startups. Apply rolling.

item.title: Python data science: project-based skills
item.description: Hands-on 8-week bootcamp. Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam region (online option). Free.

item.title: One-stop support: any founder, any question

item.title: Export subsidy: recoup Middle East shipping costs

item.title: Tech incubator in Busan: open door policy
item.description: Lab space, R&D facilities, patent support. Rolling admits. Focus: deep tech commercialization.

item.title: Chungju biotech: join the cluster council
item.description: Network of biohealth leaders. Monthly convenings, deal flow, mentorship.

item.title: Deep Tech Studio: license university research

item.title: Drone defense: specialized startup school
item.description: Daejeon-based bootcamp for defense + drone founders. Mentoring, procurement connections, funding.

item.title: Protect your tech: early warning monitoring
item.description: IP theft prevention for SMEs. Patent watch + competitor tracking. Free assessment.

item.title: Gumi startup makerspace: prototype + sell faster
item.description: Free workshop access, equipment rental, product testing. Electronics/hardware focus.

item.title: Demo day + mentoring: connect to Seoul VCs
item.description: Gyeongnam startups pitch in Seoul. Investor intros, scale-up workshops. Spring 2026.

item.title: Food manufacturing: free tech consulting
item.description: Seongnam small manufacturers get process + equipment advice. May cohort open.

item.title: Digital health bootcamp: go from idea to MVP
item.description: Free hands-on course + 1:1 expert consulting. Big data + AI in healthcare.

item.title: Labor academy: free compliance + leadership training

item.title: Social business: facility + operating cost grants

item.title: University incubator: spring workspace + mentoring

item.title: Air Force hackathon: solve military innovation
item.description: Co-hosted with Korean Air Force. Build next-gen defense tech ideas. May hackathon.

item.title: Expand globally: Korea's 2026 international market access program
item.description: Fund and support for Korean companies entering global markets. Get backing for overseas expansion strategy, market research, and international partnerships.

item.description: Free compliance consulting sent to your office for small/understaffed firms. Prevent labor violations with real-world, tailored advice.
